title: When will the deployment circuit breaker trip?
description: Choose the failure stage, service size, and observed failures. The lab reproduces the documented ECS rolling-deployment threshold and separates failure detection from rollback.

failureStages.label: Task cannot reach RUNNING
failureStages.detail: Model image pull, resource initialization, networking, or application-start failures before a task reaches RUNNING.
failureStages.signal: Each task in the deployment that fails to reach RUNNING increments the stage-one failure count.

failureStages.label: Running task fails health checks
failureStages.detail: Model a task that starts but is replaced after a supported load-balancer, service-discovery, or container health check fails.
failureStages.signal: After at least one task reaches RUNNING, replacements caused by supported health-check failures increment the stage-two count.
